verdict.rationale: The product exposes a scriptable CLI (`npx skills add/update`) that supports non-interactive flags, and a probe confirms it can be driven end-to-end without prompts, which functions as a de facto programmatic interface for agentic automation. However there is no formal documented public API (REST/SDK/schema) beyond a handful of CLI commands, and no reference docs enumerating a full command/flag surface. Missing for 10: a proper API/CLI reference doc, broader command coverage beyond add/update, and independent confirmation of programmatic reliability at scale.
